_comment: What the relay's usage lines are priced at. Check these against the provider pricing pages before you trust a report; they are rates, not measurements. A transcribe line from v0.6.4 or later carries token counts and is priced from transcribe_per_million_tokens; older lines are priced from transcribe_per_minute. The audio token rate is derived: OpenAI's table publishes text input, output, and an estimated per-minute cost, and that estimate equals the audio rate at their nominal 1000 audio tokens a minute ($6/M -> $0.006/min, $3/M -> $0.003/min). Anthropic: https://www.anthropic.com/pricing  OpenAI: https://openai.com/api/pricing
